title: Melody to MIDI
prompt: Start a new song in ~/music/unidaw-short-midi at 96 BPM with one 8-bar section called Verse. Put melody.wav from that folder on an audio track called Melody. Then turn the melody (a single line) into MIDI notes on a new track called Lead and let the 4OSC synth play it with a bright lead sound. Mute the Melody track.
